sources.citation: Kimmelman, Vadim. 2014. Information Structure in Russian Sign Language and Sign Language of the Netherlands. PhD dissertation, Universiteit van Amsterdam (ACLC). 290 pp. hdl 11245/1.432175
sources.note: 'Stress' treated only as prosodic focus marking: sec. 2.3.2 'Prosodic/stress marking' (pp.29-30) reviews stress-as-focus in ASL/DGS/NGT (stressed signs longer, larger, faster); ch.4 and sec. 7.4.1 (p.223) report RSL focus is marked by manual prosodic prominence (modified movement/location of the focused sign). No statement about word-level stress placement; no claim that RSL has or lacks lexical stress.
